rocker.name: Joystick
rocker.desc: Brief description: the up/down/left/right/center button code values are keycodes — look them up in the included keycode-android.java file. The elementId value is unique. middleCode is the small center dot; double-tap to trigger it.

dpad.name: D-Pad
dpad.desc: Brief description: the up/down/left/right button code values are keycodes — look them up in the included keycode-android.java file. The elementId value is unique.

mouse.name: ML
mouse.desc: Brief description: the code value is fixed. 'name' is the button display label — ML = left click, MM = middle click, MR = right click.

mouse.name: TP(R)
mouse.desc: Special trackpad button, great for rotating the camera in WoW. The 'name' value can be cleared, but keeping it helps tell buttons apart — feel free to rename it.

mouse.name: TP(L)
mouse.desc: Holds down the left mouse button continuously.
